SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_members,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur_rows, min(valid_from), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS cur_members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)) AS orphan_home
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.home_store_id, m.marketing_consent, s.store_name
  FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND st.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT c.home_store_id, c.store_name, count(DISTINCT c.member_id) AS members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.member_id END) AS active_52w,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.marketing_consent THEN c.member_id END) AS consent
FROM cur c LEFT JOIN act a ON a.member_id = c.member_id
GROUP BY ROLLUP(1,2) ORDER BY 1

FROM dim_member m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
